Sidorovich, I take it you fix guns... and body armor too?

Ah... you mean that thing in the vise? It'll be a fine piece when I'm done. An expensive one, too. So what needs fixing? Fair warning: the worse the wear, the more it'll cost. Well?\n \nAvailable repairs:

Marked One, you really took a beating. Now, where did I put those armor plates? Ah, here they are... there we go... phew.\n \nThere you go. Good as new!
Hm. Nice work. Say, where'd you learn to do that? No answer? Suit yourself.
Nice work. I can see what I'm paying for.

Sure. Let's see it.\n \nAvailable repairs:
Barkeep, you don't happen to fix guns, do you?
Me? No. But there's a stalker working off his debts in the kitchen. Hell of a gunsmith. Guns, armor, you name it. I'll put him on it. So what needs fixing?\n \nAvailable repairs:

Here. It's all patched up!
Would you look at that? It's good as new! Your gunsmith really knows his stuff. Give him my regards.
Yeah, that's some fine work!
Can he fix something else?
Sure. He's got nothing on right now anyway.\n \nAvailable repairs:
Do you do repairs, Professor?
I can take a break from my research if need be. I don't have many tools, though. Repairs are only a hobby of mine, so it won't be cheap.\n \nAvailable repairs:

Give me a moment...\n \nThat should do it. Here you are!
Armor plates are in short supply here, but I've got a few tucked away. Wait here...\n \nThere. That should hold up.
Nice work! You could make a living as a gunsmith.
You can sleep easy, Professor. That's first-rate work!
Could you fix something else?
Very well. I can do it while the data's still processing.\n \nAvailable repairs:
Sorry, I'm here to get my gear fixed. What do you charge?
Ha! Don't worry, I won't take the shirt off your back. I'm not as stingy as they say. So what needs fixing? The more beat-up it is, the more it'll cost. Well?\n \nAvailable repairs:

Swapped out a few parts, cleaned it and oiled it...\n \nEnjoy!
Marked One, have you got a sign on you that says 'Shoot here'? All right, hand it over. I'll fix it...\n \nOnly the freshest armor plates, straight out of the fridge! I covered up the sign, too.
Good as new! Nice work!
Very funny... Though it does look better now!
Can you fix one more thing?
Sure, as long as you remember to pay. I don't do repairs on credit.\n \nAvailable repairs:
